name: Yves Camdeborde
bio: French chef trained at the Ritz, La Tour d'Argent and the Hôtel de Crillon. In 1992 he bought La Régalade in Paris, cooked there at a low fixed price, and gave the bistro style a name that the press called bistronomie.

milestones.event: Bought the restaurant La Régalade in the 14th arrondissement of Paris.
Opened Le Comptoir du Relais in the Saint-Germain quarter.
